✦ 5-Stage Speechwriting Roadmap

STAGE 1

Outline & Ideas

Opening hook, main Torah thought, and personal takeaway.

STAGE 2

Drafting Speech

Writing the full paragraphs, stories, and thank-yous.

STAGE 3

Editing & Polish

Refining word choice, sentence flow, and speech length.

STAGE 4

Delivery & Pacing

Practicing speaking speed (~125 words/min) and eye contact.

STAGE 5

Mastered & Ready

Full confidence, final printed copies, and rehearsal complete.

1. Personal Connection Token

Generate a revocable Bearer token for your external AI. No raw database keys are ever exposed.

Active Bearer Token (Copy & paste into your AI platform's Authorization header):

2. Declared Capabilities (Strict Server Allowlist)

Your external AI can ONLY perform the exact 3 capabilities enabled below, matching My Agent inside TutorPilot.

Always Blocked by Server (HTTP 403): Deleting or creating students, editing or deleting courses and lessons, reading private guardian contact info, billing rates, or portal codes, and changing account settings.

3. Universal Setup Guideline (Any AI Platform)

Gateway Endpoint URL
Universal OpenAPI Schema URL
Universal Agent Instructions (Copy & paste into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any custom AI)
ChatGPT (Custom GPT Actions)
Configure -> Create New Action -> Import from OpenAPI URL -> Auth: API Key (Bearer) -> paste token & instructions.
Claude / Gemini / Custom Agent
Attach OpenAPI tool or HTTP connector to /api/external-agent with header Authorization: Bearer tp_ext_... and paste instructions.
